segments.text: Got a bit of an idea that's interesting for a video, which is to sell the Ivy product itself. It's to get several creators and have them talking to the device, with the hook being that the ideas are connected into something like...
Mr. Beast's viral video that I was watching the other day on YouTube.
If you can find it — the Mr. Beast viral video she watched on YouTube.

The video should be pretty short. I'm thinking we have it in different hands and different people, and the goal of the video is to make the product, then the AI, then the output, and then a video all really seamless, all really fun. Fun is the goal — make the UI and the AI really personable and optimistic around great ideas and talkative, and show the visuals of that.
Like to have your thoughts on it and put together some ideas and storyboards and even some demo concepts.

cards.title: Sell Ivy through several creators talking
cards.gist: A video that sells the Ivy product by putting the device in the hands of several creators talking to it, with the hook that their ideas get connected.

cards.title: Mr. Beast viral video as reference
cards.gist: She points to a Mr. Beast viral video she watched on YouTube as the model for how the connected-ideas hook should feel.
cards.their_idea: A viral Mr. Beast YouTube video she watched recently.
cards.her_take: Use its structure as the reference for connecting the creators' ideas together in the Ivy video.

cards.title: Short, seamless, fun product-to-video flow
cards.gist: Keep the video short, pass the device between different hands and people, and make product → AI → output → video feel seamless and fun with a personable, optimistic, talkative AI shown visually.

loose_ends.text: Find the Mr. Beast viral video she watched on YouTube the other day.

requests.text: Give thoughts on the video idea and put together ideas, storyboards and demo concepts.
